verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents its own ways to move workload data off the platform. The CLI hello-world flow includes a 'copy data' step, SSH access supports file transfer, and the REST API offers programmatic control over the whole platform, so files on instances and volumes can be retrieved in whatever format the user created them. Nothing describes a dedicated export or exit path for account-level data or confirms open export formats. Missing for 10: a documented full-account export (billing, instance history, templates, settings), explicit open-format export guarantees, offboarding or account-deletion guidance, and independent corroboration of a clean exit.
